answers.note: Антарктида получает крайне мало осадков и считается самым сухим материком.
Ледниковый щит делает Антарктиду самым высоким материком по средней высоте поверхности.
Антарктида имеет самые низкие зарегистрированные температуры среди материков.
На склонах Антарктиды возникают особенно сильные и устойчивые катабатические ветры.

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The stem now asks only for the temperature superlative. AAP identifies Antarctica as coldest, driest and windiest at L298, and states the coldest-continent classification explicitly at L315; it separately identifies highest at L298. The four actual options each describe one distinct continental superlative; only “coldest” answers the temperature-specific stem.
finalGroupBindings.locator: AAP Antarctic geography and geology L298,L313-L315; AAP Antarctic weather L299.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Антарктида — самый холодный материк Земли. На станции Восток в 1983 году зарегистрировали −89,2 °C — самую низкую температуру у поверхности Земли.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: AAP explicitly calls Antarctica the coldest continent and states the lowest surface temperature record was −89.2°C at Vostok in 1983. The weather page independently gives the same surface record.
finalGroupBindings.locator: AAP Antarctic geography and geology L313-L315; AAP Antarctic weather L334; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L6.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Антарктида получает крайне мало осадков и считается самым сухим материком.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: AAP describes Antarctica as the driest continent and quantifies mean accumulation as water equivalent to about 150 mm annually, under 50 mm on the elevated plateau.
finalGroupBindings.locator: AAP Antarctic geography and geology L298,L307-L308; AAP Antarctic weather L344-L349; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L4.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Средняя высота поверхности Антарктиды — около 2500 м, что выше, чем у любого другого материка.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: AAP gives mean elevation of 2,500 m and labels Antarctica the highest continent; the stated comparison with Australia (330 m) makes the high average concrete. BAS reports mean altitude of 2,300 m and a plateau above 4,000 m.
finalGroupBindings.locator: AAP Antarctic geography and geology L298,L302-L305; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L1.

finalGroupBindings.literal: На станции Восток в 1983 году зарегистрировали −89,2 °C — самую низкую температуру у поверхности Земли.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Australian Antarctic Program identifies −89.2°C at Vostok in 1983 as the lowest surface temperature recorded on Earth; BAS also identifies Vostok as the record station.
finalGroupBindings.locator: AAP Antarctic geography and geology L313-L315; AAP Antarctic weather L334; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L6.

finalGroupBindings.literal: На склонах Антарктиды возникают особенно сильные и устойчивые катабатические ветры.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: AAP states Antarctica is the windiest continent and describes consistent katabatic winds flowing downhill; speeds can exceed 100 km/h for days. BAS links strong katabatic winds to windy coastal sites.
finalGroupBindings.locator: AAP Antarctic geography and geology L309-L311; AAP Antarctic weather L335-L343; BAS Weather in the Antarctic L11.
